The parts ads often leave out

  • You may be away from home for months.
  • Shared cabins and shift work are common.
  • Ask for a written explanation of the next steps.

See the document checklist
Avoid the scam traps

Check the details before you decide.

Verify the institution and course through current official sources. Ask who receives each payment and obtain receipts. Be cautious of unexplained cash requests, agents who refuse employer verification, or anyone promising a joining date without a documented process.

Your questions, answered.

What is the total cost?

Your counsellor will share the complete cost sheet in writing during your counselling call, before you enrol.

Is life onboard safe, and is it suitable for girls?

Ships are structured, supervised workplaces with clear routines and support onboard. During counselling we discuss daily life, safety and what to expect, so you and your family can decide with full information.

What is the difference between Cruise Line and Merchant Navy careers?

Cruise line careers are guest service and hospitality roles aboard passenger ships. Merchant Navy careers are technical and deck roles aboard commercial ships. Both can lead to global work. The right fit depends on your aptitude and goals, which is what the counselling call is for.
